block.description: Imports an IAM configuration into the MinIO server (users, groups, policies, service accounts). Pair with `data.minio_iam_export` for cross-cluster migration or backup/restore. MinIO's export embeds non-deterministic zip metadata, so chaining `data.minio_iam_export` -> `minio_iam_import` in the same root module shows drift on every plan even when IAM is unchanged. For stable plans, run export and import in separate states, or set `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [iam_data] }` once the initial import has succeeded. Delete is a no-op: MinIO does not provide a primitive to undo an import. To purge imported entities, manage them as individual `minio_iam_*` resources or remove them out-of-band.

block.description:
Decommissions a storage pool from a MinIO cluster. WARNING: this is a destructive and irreversible operation — once decommission completes, MinIO removes the pool and the data on it cannot be recovered via Terraform. Ensure all data has been migrated before applying.

Create returns as soon as MinIO accepts the request; the decommission then runs asynchronously on the server. Refresh the resource (or read the `minio_pool_status` data source) to observe progress in the `state` and `status` attributes.

Destroying the resource cancels an in-progress decommission (no-op once the pool has already been removed).

block.description:
Manages MinIO Prometheus bearer tokens for metrics authentication.

Bearer tokens are JWTs signed with MinIO credentials that authenticate
requests to Prometheus metrics endpoints. Each metric type (cluster, node,
bucket, resource) can have its own token.

Tokens are generated locally using the provider's access and secret keys,
so no API call is needed to create them. The token is valid for the specified
duration from creation time.

mode.description:
Retention mode for the bucket. Valid values are:
                - GOVERNANCE: Prevents object modification by non-privileged users. Users with s3:BypassGovernanceRetention permission can modify objects.
                - COMPLIANCE: Prevents any object modification by all users, including the root user, until retention period expires.

validity_period.description: Duration for which objects should be retained under WORM lock, in the specified unit. Must be a positive integer.

block.description:
Manages object lock retention settings for a MinIO bucket. Object locking enforces Write-Once Read-Many (WORM) immutability to protect versioned objects from deletion.

Note: Object locking can only be enabled during bucket creation and requires versioning. You cannot enable object locking on an existing bucket.

This resource provides compliance with SEC17a-4(f), FINRA 4511(C), and CFTC 1.31(c)-(d) requirements.

bucket_name.description: The name of the bucket containing the object

checksum_crc32.description: The CRC32 checksum of the object

checksum_crc32c.description: The CRC32C checksum of the object

checksum_sha1.description: The SHA1 checksum of the object

checksum_sha256.description: The SHA256 checksum of the object

content_type.description: The content type of the object

expiration_rule_id.description: The lifecycle expiry-date and ruleID associated with the expiry

expires.description: The  date and time at which the object is no longer able to be cached

is_latest.description: Whether the object is the latest version

last_modified.description: The last modified time of the object

storage_class.description: The storage class of the object

version_id.description: The version ID of the object

block.description: Reads an object from a MinIO bucket including its content and metadata.

bucket.description: Name of the bucket to list objects from.

common_prefixes.description: List of common prefixes when using a delimiter (like subdirectories).

delimiter.description: Character used to group keys. Use '/' to browse like a filesystem.

keys.description: List of object keys matching the filter.

max_keys.description: Maximum number of keys to return.

prefix.description: Limits results to object keys that begin with this prefix.

block.description: Lists objects in an S3 bucket with optional prefix, delimiter, and max keys filtering.

commit.description: Git commit hash of the server build

deployment_id.description: Deployment ID of the MinIO cluster

edition.description: Edition the provider decided to use for this run (`AIStor` for licensed builds, empty for open-source MinIO). Reflects the manual override, ServerInfo.Edition, and License-based fallback — query this if a bug-report asks what AIStor mode is active.

servers.description: List of servers in the cluster

sqsarn.description: List of configured SQS ARNs for event notifications

block.description: Reads MinIO server information including version, deployment ID, and storage metrics.
Returns disk and drive status for all MinIO server nodes. Essential for capacity planning and health monitoring.
